review:
Magic Mummy Megaways gives ancient Egypt a comic-book makeover, with a charming mummy running a colourful tomb. The reels shift in Megaways style and symbols cascade after wins.

When the bonus starts, the mummy wakes up fully and summons boosters whose multipliers multiply together instead of adding up, which can produce large results quickly. Chance x2 doubles your chance of free spins, and the bonus can be bought where permitted. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 5,000x maximum and a 97% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 282 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
